title: Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home)
description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. description: About Popcorn Growth We are an award winning, TikTok-first, influencer marketing agency and social media company, here to shake up stuffy, old-school agency practices. Good and fast is better than slow and perfect. Stuff gets done, stuff gets done well. There are days we are motivated, there are days we are not motivated. Every day, we are disciplined. We trust each other because of transparency. We reward performance, not hours worked, not tenure. description: What you'll do: Deliver 1:1 online trial lessons, understand each child's needs, recommend the right Kodland program, and help families make a confident enrollment decision. Schedule: 20–25 hrs/week on average, mostly weekday afternoons/evenings + daytime weekends (US hours) Pay: Fixed rate per completed trial + performance bonuses — clear, transparent structure Support: Live onboarding, guided practice, and a short assessment before you start with real families If this sounds like your kind of role, here's the full picture 👇 1. About Kodland 👨‍💻👩‍💻 Kodland is an international online school helping kids aged 8–17 build real digital skills — Python, Roblox, Minecraft, Digital Creativity, and more. We work with students and families across the US, Europe, the UK, CIS, Latin America, MENA, and beyond, all through live 1:1 or small-group Zoom classes with a project-based approach. Our mission: help kids become confident, curious thinkers who are comfortable with technology and problem-solving. 🔗 Learn more about Kodland 2. A Day in the Life of a TCM 🎬 Curious what this actually looks like day to day? This short video shows a typical TCM schedule, how a real trial lesson unfolds, and what the conversation with parents feels like. 👉 Watch it before applying — it's the fastest way to know if this role fits your lifestyle. 3. What You'll Actually Be Doing 🎧 Each trial lesson, you'll: Meet the child and at least one parent on Zoom Build rapport and ask the right questions to understand the child's background, interests, and goals Lead a short hands-on activity (simple coding, game logic, or digital task) using ready-made materials Recommend the best-fit program based on what you observe Answer questions, address concerns, and guide the family to a clear decision This role blends three skill sets: 🎓 Teaching — explaining clearly and keeping kids engaged 🗣 Communication — listening well and adapting to each family 💼 Sales — showing value and confidently closing when it's a good fit This isn't a scripted call-center job. You'll get structure and materials, but you're expected to think on your feet and lead the conversation. 4. Schedule & Availability 🕒 Weekdays: mainly 14:00–21:00 CDT Weekends: mainly 11:00–18:00 CDT 5 days/week , with 1 weekday off + 1 weekend day off Exact hours are negotiable, but we need consistent weekly availability so we can plan ahead and keep families from waiting. Pay & Earning Potential 💶 Independent contractor role, paid twice a month , built on two parts: Base pay: $8 per completed trial (up to $9.50 based on your grade) Bonus: 5–10% of your monthly sales — the better your conversion rate, the higher your % 📌 Admin hours are paid at the same rate as trial classes. title: Deneme Sınıfı Yöneticisi | Türkiye
description: 💻 Kodland Hakkında Kodland , 5–17 yaş arası çocuklara programlama, matematik, dijital tasarım ve teknoloji becerileri kazandıran uluslararası bir online eğitim platformudur. Canlı online derslerimizde Python, Roblox, Minecraft, Dijital Yaratıcılık ve benzeri modern alanları proje tabanlı bir öğrenme yaklaşımıyla sunuyoruz. Türkiye ekibimize katılacak, çocuklar ve velilerle birebir online deneme dersleri gerçekleştirecek Online Eğitim ve Satış Danışmanları (TCM) arıyoruz. Bu pozisyon klasik bir öğretmenlik rolü değildir. Eğitim danışmanlığı, güçlü iletişim ve sonuç odaklı satışın birleştiği bir çalışma modelidir. 🎯 Bu rolde ne yapacaksın? Zoom üzerinden çocuk ve en az bir velinin katıldığı, yaklaşık 60 dakikalık online deneme dersleri gerçekleştireceksin. Görüşme boyunca: Çocuk ve veliyle güvene dayalı iletişim kuracak, Çocuğun ilgi alanlarını, hedeflerini ve eğitim ihtiyaçlarını anlayacak, Hazır Kodland materyalleriyle kısa bir uygulamalı aktivite yönetecek, Gözlemlerine göre en uygun kursu ve öğrenme modelini önerecek, Velilerin sorularını yanıtlayacak ve tereddütlerini profesyonel şekilde ele alacak, Uygun ailelerde kayıt, fiyatlandırma ve ödeme sürecini sonuçlandırmaya odaklanacaksın. Kendi müşterini veya öğrencini bulman beklenmez. Görüşmeler, önceden belirlediğin çalışma programına göre Kodland tarafından planlanır. Hazır ders yapısı, materyaller, eğitim ve ekip desteği sağlanır. Senden beklenen; görüşmeyi aktif şekilde yönetmen, ailelerin ihtiyaçlarını doğru anlaman, Kodland programlarının değerini net şekilde göstermen ve satış fırsatlarını sonuca ulaştırmandır. 🕒 Çalışma Modeli Bu rol tamamen uzaktan ve freelance çalışma modeliyle yürütülür. Haftada 5 gün Haftada minimum 20–25 saat uygunluk Hafta içi çalışma aralığı: 13.00–22.00 Hafta sonu çalışma aralığı: 10.00–22.00 Çalışma saatlerini bu zaman aralıkları içerisinde planlayabilirsin. Ailelerin görüşmeleri açtığın saatlere göre oluşturulduğu için programına düzenli ve tutarlı şekilde bağlı kalman beklenir. Genellikle bir hafta içi ve bir hafta sonu günü izin olarak seçilebilir. 💰 Kazanç Modeli Bu pozisyonda toplam kazanç aşağıdaki bileşenlerden oluşur: Sabit ücret Satış komisyonları Performans primleri Haftada yaklaşık 20–25 saat çalışan ekip üyeleri genellikle aylık 30.000–50.000 TL aralığında kazanç elde eder. Güçlü ve istikrarlı satış performansı gösteren ekip üyeleri ise 70.000 TL ve üzeri kazanca ulaşabilir. description: THE COMPANY Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. THE ROLE We are seeking a talented and motivated Graduate Digital Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design and verification of digital and mixed-signal IP for our chiplet solutions, including PCS (Physical Coding Sublayer) logic and custom high-speed interfaces such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe. Working alongside experienced digital and analog engineers, you will write RTL, build testbenches and behavioural models, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in digital design who want to learn fast through hands-on work in a small, high-impact team. Floorplanning & Power Delivery: Define floorplans, power grids and macro/pin placement. Make the key area, congestion and power-distribution trade-offs, including for blocks that interface with sensitive analog circuits. Timing Closure & Constraints: Write and validate SDC constraints, and drive STA and timing closure across corners and modes for high-speed designs. This includes multi-clock, CDC-heavy and high-frequency datapaths between PCS, DSP and analog front-ends. Mixed-Signal Integration: Integrate hard analog and custom-layout macros (e.g. SerDes TX/RX, PLLs, ADC/DAC) with digital logic. Manage abstracts, pin and bump planning, shielding, isolation and top-level assembly together with the analog and layout teams. Sign-off: Make sure blocks are ready for tape-out through IR-drop and EM analysis, physical verification (DRC/LVS/antenna/ERC), logic equivalence checking, parasitic extraction and final sign-off STA. Low-Power & DFT: Implement UPF power intent where needed, and work with DFT to integrate scan, BIST and test structures without compromising PPA. Flows & Automation: Build and improve our implementation flows and scripts (TCL, Python, shell). This includes AI-assisted tools that parse, compare and flag regressions across timing, congestion and power reports between runs. Feedback to Design: Feed physical implementation insights back to RTL and architecture teams early, so designs are built to close. Collaboration & Mentoring

description: Du baust als erste CRM-Person das Retention-Ressort einer Supplement-Marke mit über 200.000 Kund:innen auf — von null, mit eigenem Budget und Tool-Stack. Die Kanäle spielen zusammen. E-Mail, SMS und WhatsApp sind ein Lifecycle statt drei Silos — und WhatsApp ist ein eigener Retention-Kanal mit eigener Liste. Loyalty ist live, das Abo wächst. Du hast ein Loyalty-Programm ausgewählt, gebaut und gelauncht und das Abo-Programm bei Quote, Churn und Kündigungsstrecken weiterentwickelt. Die Zahlen sind deine. Wie hier gearbeitet wird Supplement Hub ist effizienzgetrieben: Calls gibt es, wenn sie nötig sind, Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen.
